en: A black and white postcard depicting a picturesque riverside town with historic architecture and hillside buildings. The foreground shows a riverbank with stone embankments and a few buildings close to the water. In the mid-ground, residential buildings rise from the shore onto a hill adorned with trees and larger, castle-like structures at the top. In the background, the town continues with church spires visible. The handwritten text in the corner reads 'Meißen-rechts.'
